title: Finite polynomial inverse certificate
statement: Let $R$ be a commutative ring, $n,m\geq0$, $P=R[x_1,\ldots,x_n]$ [def-weil-pbc-mv-polynomial-ring], and $f_1,\ldots,f_m\in P$. Put $J=(f_1,\ldots,f_m)$. A polynomial inverse certificate for $f$ means a family $c_{jk}\in P$ such that $\sum_j c_{jk}\partial_l f_j-\delta_{kl}\in J$ for every $k,l$, and $\sum_k(\partial_k f_j)\sum_a c_{ak}f_a-f_j\in J^2$ for every $j$, with partial derivatives as in [def-weil-pbc-polynomial-partial-derivative]. Here $\delta_{kl}=1$ when $k=l$ and $0$ otherwise; $J^2$ is generated by products of two elements of $J$.
